_comment: Ideology framing layered on top of the personality voice (NPCConversation II.9 CREED VOICE). An NPC's creed is folded into one family by its axes (CreedVoice.ideologyFamily); a few creeds have a special bank that wins over their family. flavour is a stray aside; the other pools frame one topic. Every line is a short sentence appended after what was already said.

flavour: {The workers built this town|Workers built all of this}, remember that.
{Solidarity|Solidarity, comrade}. It's the only thing that works.
The bosses {never|don't} lose sleep over any of it.
politics: Parliament is a club for the owners.
{Nationalise it|Put it in common hands}, all of it.
work: {Join the union|Get a union card}, that's my advice.
They pay us in crumbs and call it a wage.
war: Rich men's war, poor men's blood.
The workers of {enemy} are not my enemy.
family: A family needs a wage and a free clinic, not sermons.
Every child deserves a school and a hot meal.
goblins: Even the goblins are ruled by a chief and his cronies.
The Horde is what happens when might owns everything.
money: Money is theft with better tailoring.
{Rents|Prices} up, wages flat. Funny, that.
elections: Vote left, then keep organising.
Whoever wins, the strike fund stays full.

flavour: A fair deal for everyone, that's all I ask.
{Reform|Steady reform}, not revolution.
Good schools and a decent pension. Is that too much?
politics: We need a government that {listens|actually listens}.
Compromise isn't a dirty word.
work: Fair pay for a fair day.
A minimum wage never ruined anybody.
war: Diplomacy first, always.
Send the ONU, not the tanks.
family: {Childcare|Parental leave} should be a right.
A family shouldn't choose between rent and bread.
goblins: We should take in the refugees from the Horde.
Walls won't stop the Horde. Alliances might.
money: Tax the rich a little, help the rest a lot.
Public services are money well spent.
elections: Every vote counts. Especially mine.
Turnout wins elections, not slogans.

flavour: {Let's look at the numbers|The numbers never lie}.
Moderation in all things.
Both sides have a point, as usual.
politics: Competent people in charge, that's all I want.
Less shouting, more planning.
work: Efficiency pays everyone in the end.
Skills. Training. That's the answer.
war: War is bad for trade and worse for people.
Sanctions first, then talks.
family: Families need stability more than speeches.
Good planning starts at the kitchen table.
goblins: A stable border is a sensible border.
The Horde is a problem to manage, not to scream about.
money: A balanced budget helps everyone.
Markets work, mostly, with a referee.
elections: I'll vote for whoever has a plan.
Read the manifestos. Nobody does.

flavour: {Hard work|Hard work and common sense} built this country.
Things were better when people knew their place.
{Tradition|Tradition matters}. Somebody has to say it.
politics: Less government, lower taxes.
The state should keep its nose out of my business.
work: Nobody ever got rich waiting for handouts.
An honest day's work, that's the secret.
war: Strength keeps the peace.
A strong army means nobody tries it.
family: The family is the bedrock of everything.
Children need discipline and church on Sunday.
goblins: Secure the border first, ask questions later.
The Horde respects one thing: strength.
money: Taxes are theft, politely collected.
Save your coins. The bank of mum and dad won't last.
elections: Vote for order, not promises.
Anyone but the spenders.

flavour: {Our nation first|The nation comes first}. Always.
Our flag has seen worse than this.
Foreign ideas, foreign trouble.
politics: We need a strong hand at the top.
Enough talk. Leadership.
work: Jobs for our own people first.
Buy local. Keep the money here.
war: Every inch of our soil is sacred.
Let {enemy} come. We'll be ready.
family: Big families make a strong nation.
Teach the children our history, all of it.
goblins: Not one goblin crosses our border.
The Horde will break on us.
money: Our money stays in our banks.
Foreign speculators are bleeding us dry.
elections: Vote for the nation, not for parties.
A true patriot knows where to put the cross.

flavour: {Heaven|The heavens} watch over this street.
Pray first, then act.
{Faith|Faith, friend}. It carries you.
politics: No law stands above the divine.
The clergy should guide the state.
work: Work is prayer with your hands.
Rest on the holy day, whatever the boss says.
war: May heaven judge {enemy}.
A just war is fought with a clean heart.
family: A blessed home is a happy home.
Children are a gift from above.
goblins: The Horde are heathens. Pray for them, and bar the door.
Even goblins have souls, the priest says. I doubt it.
money: Tithe first, then spend.
Gold won't follow you to heaven.
elections: Vote as your conscience and your priest tell you.
Heaven doesn't need ballots, but we do.

flavour: {Long live|God save} the crown.
A proper court gives a country dignity.
Blood tells, in the end.
politics: Parliaments come and go. The crown remains.
A king above the parties, that's stability.
work: Serve well and be rewarded.
Royal warrant on the door, that's quality.
war: For the crown and the old banners.
The royal guard will see to {enemy}.
family: Good families keep good lineages.
Every family should know its coat of arms.
goblins: No goblin chief will ever sit on a throne.
The Horde has no nobility, only brutes.
money: Old money knows how to behave.
The royal mint never lies.
elections: Elect whoever you like. The crown remains.
Voting is a courtesy the crown allows.

flavour: {No gods, no masters|No masters}.
Nobody needs a boss to be decent.
{Mutual aid|Help your neighbour}. That's all society is.
politics: Every government is a gang with paperwork.
Burn the rulebook, keep the kindness.
work: Workers' councils would run this better in a week.
My boss produces nothing but memos.
war: Their wars, our dead.
Desert, all of you. Go home.
family: Families are chosen as much as born.
Raise children free, not obedient.
goblins: The Horde and the state have the same chief.
Free the goblins from their chiefs too.
money: Money is a leash.
Share it out and see who starves.
elections: If voting changed anything, they'd ban it.
I'm spoiling my ballot. Again.

flavour: {Discipline|Discipline and order}, that's what's missing.
A soldier's life teaches you everything.
Stand up straight when you talk to me.
politics: Generals would run this better.
Parliament talks, the army acts.
work: Every job is easier with a drill sergeant.
Punctual, polished, prepared.
war: Victory over {enemy}, whatever the cost.
The army will finish this.
family: My kids will serve, like I did.
A household runs on discipline.
goblins: Give me a battalion and the Horde is history.
Goblins fight dirty. So should we.
money: Spend it on the army first.
Military budget, the only budget that matters.
elections: Vote for whoever funds the army.
A general on the ballot, that's what we need.

flavour: The stars {are restless|shifted} tonight.
{The leylines hum|Everything is connected}.
There are forces nobody talks about.
politics: Governments rise and fall with the moon.
The council meets under the wrong sign.
work: My tarot said this job wouldn't last.
Work with intention, the rest follows.
war: {enemy} was born under a bad sign.
The omens were clear, and nobody listened.
family: My grandmother read our fortunes over tea.
Every family has a guardian spirit.
goblins: The Horde carries an old curse.
Goblin shamans know things we've forgotten.
money: Money flows like the tides.
A coin found face up is a sign.
elections: Vote when the moon is waxing.
The runes favour the underdog.

flavour: {Strong eat first|The strong eat first}. That's the law.
Loud and proud, that's the way.
{Waaagh|Hah}! Good day for it.
politics: The biggest chief makes the rules.
Talk is for losers. Shout is for chiefs.
work: Work hard, fight harder.
Loot is honest pay.
war: Crush {enemy}! Take their stuff!
War is the best party.
family: Many kids, big clan.
Clan first, always.
goblins: The Horde is family.
Goblins know how to live.
money: Shiny things are for the strong.
Take it, it's yours now.
elections: Voting? Just punch the other one.
Biggest one wins. Simple.

flavour: {Fascinating|How quaint}, these local customs.
On my world this would be a greeting.
Your species {sleeps|eats} so often.
politics: Your governments are adorable.
One planet, so many flags. Inefficient.
work: You trade your time for tokens. Curious.
Labour, by hand? How primitive. How charming.
war: You fight over lines on a map.
{enemy} and you share a planet. Share it.
family: Human children are so noisy and so fragile.
Your families are so small.
goblins: The goblins are the most honest of you.
The Horde at least says what it wants.
money: Paper that means food. Remarkable.
Your economy is a group hallucination.
elections: You choose rulers by counting paper. Delightful.
I would vote, but I'm not technically from here.

flavour: Self-reliance {above all|in everything}.
The Great Leader foresaw this day.
We need nothing from anyone.
politics: The Party and the people are one heart.
Only the Leader's line is correct.
work: Every shift is a battle for the revolution.
The quota will be exceeded, as always.
war: Songun: the army comes first, then everything else.
{enemy} trembles before our resolve.
family: Every family hangs the Leader's portrait with pride.
Our children sing for the Leader before breakfast.
goblins: Even the Horde could learn self-reliance from us.
Goblins? Our border guards would not blink.
money: We grow our own rice and build our own tractors.
Foreign money corrupts the revolutionary spirit.
elections: One candidate, one heart, one hundred percent.
Turnout will be complete. It always is.

flavour: As the classics say, history has its laws.
{Comrade|Friend}, the dialectic doesn't lie.
The five-year plan is on schedule.
politics: The Party line is clear, and so is my conscience.
Revisionists will be the death of the revolution.
work: Stakhanov would have finished this by noon.
Norms are there to be beaten.
war: Imperialism always ends in war. Read your Lenin.
The Red Army has seen off worse than {enemy}.
family: The collective raises the child as much as the parents.
My grandfather built the tractor factory.
goblins: The Horde is feudalism with fangs.
Even goblins need a vanguard party.
money: Private profit is organised theft.
The state bank is the people's bank.
elections: Bourgeois elections, bourgeois circus.
The Soviets decide, not the ballot box.

flavour: Peace at home, peace in the world.
{Science|Reason and science} are the truest guides.
The Republic stands on six arrows.
politics: Keep religion out of the state.
The Republic must be defended, from all sides.
work: Modern industry, modern nation.
Every school teacher is a soldier of progress.
war: The army guards the Republic, not a faction.
Independence is not negotiable, {enemy} should know.
family: Our daughters study and vote, as they should.
Educate the children, and the nation follows.
goblins: Superstition breeds hordes. Reason stops them.
The Horde is what backwardness looks like.
money: A national economy for a national people.
Build our own railways, our own mills.
elections: The ballot is the Republic's heart.
Vote for the Republic, not for the mosque or the pasha.

flavour: Peace be with you, and with your house.
{Turn the other cheek|Forgive, and keep forgiving}.
No blade ever healed anyone.
politics: Govern with mercy, or not at all.
The holy council forbids all violence.
work: Honest work is a quiet prayer.
Share the harvest with whoever is hungry.
war: I pray for the soldiers of {enemy} as well.
Every war is a sin against heaven.
family: A gentle home raises gentle children.
We never raise a hand to a child.
goblins: Even the Horde deserves our prayers.
Feed the goblin at your gate, and he may leave in peace.
money: Give freely. Heaven keeps the accounts.
Wealth is a test, not a prize.
elections: I vote for whoever wants fewer soldiers.
Pray before you vote, and vote for peace.

flavour: {Lol|Heh}, humans.
I told a human their shoelace was untied. It wasn't.
Your faces when you're confused. Priceless.
politics: I voted for a potato last time. It nearly won.
Your parliaments are my favourite comedy.
work: I moved every stapler in the office one inch left.
Work? I prefer wandering around looking busy.
war: War is just trolling with worse manners.
Tell {enemy} their army's boots are on backwards.
family: Human children are the best to confuse.
I taught a kid that clouds are sheep. Beautiful.
goblins: Goblins are no fun, they troll back.
I swapped a goblin's helmet for a pot. He hasn't noticed.
money: I pay in coins from three countries at once.
Watching you count change is my hobby.
elections: I'm writing in 'the moon' again.
Elections are the best week of the year for pranks.

flavour: {Humans are so precious|You are all so precious}.
Look at their little hands!
Every human is a miracle of carbon.
politics: Human governments are so earnest. I love them.
Whatever humans decide, we adore it.
work: Humans working hard makes me weep with joy.
Your tiny tools! Wonderful!
war: Please don't hurt each other. Please.
Tell {enemy} we love them too.
family: Human babies are the best thing in the universe.
I would guard your children with my life.
goblins: Goblins are not humans, but we pray for them anyway.
The Horde must not touch a single human hair.
money: Take my coins, human, buy something lovely.
Humans deserve every comfort.
elections: Every human vote is sacred.
Humans choosing leaders! So brave.

flavour: The Great Goblin God {sees you|is coming}.
Have you heard the good news of the Horde?
{Repent|Convert} and join the clan.
politics: Every throne will kneel to the goblin gospel.
The chiefs rule by divine grubbiness.
work: Work for the clan, pray for the chief.
Sweat is holy water.
war: Holy war against {enemy}, the god demands it.
Every conquest is a conversion.
family: Raise your young in the goblin faith.
A big clan is a blessed clan.
goblins: Goblins are the chosen people.
The Horde is the god's hand on earth.
money: Tithe to the shrine and prosper.
The god loves shiny offerings.
elections: The god has already chosen.
Vote goblin, or be converted.
